claim: Seven entries share 317 George St, Suite 320 (Brach Eichler, Leon Matchin, Shaw Divorce & Family Law, Adam C Brown, Easy Prep Tax, Comprehensive Wealth Strategies, Richmond Asset Management)
problem: Suite 320 at 317 George St is advertised as a Regus/Davinci virtual-office addresss (mail and business-address packages), so these may be registered addresses rather than staffed offices. Brach Eichler is a Roseland-based firm using the suite as a satellite. The list flags this in caveats but still counts seven separate local prospects.
fix: Treat as one address with unverified staffing; confirm a person actually answers locally before any outreach, and down-rank or flag these rows.

claim: K+C Bookkeeping Services LLC (109 Church St, 732-745-8090) and North East Title Agency (109 Church St, 732-745-8090)
